protract.definition: v lengthen in time; cause to be or last longer
protract.translation:
vt. 延长, 拖延, 伸出, 绘制
[法] 延迟, 拖延, 延长

protracted.definition:
v lengthen in time; cause to be or last longer
s relatively long in duration; tediously protracted

protracted meeting.translation: (持续一段时间的)信仰复兴布道会, 奋兴布道会

protractedly.definition: r in a slow, leisurely or prolonged way

protractile.translation: a. 可伸出的, 可突出的

protracting.definition: p. pr. vb. n. of Protract
protracting.translation: v. <贬>延长, 拖延（某事物）( protract的现在分词 )

protraction.definition:
n the consequence of being lengthened in duration
n the act of prolonging something
protraction.translation:
n. 拖长, 伸长, 制图
[医] [颌]前伸

protractor.definition: n. drafting instrument used to draw or measure angles
protractor.translation:
n. 拖延者, 分度器, 牵引肌, 钳取器
[医] 取钳器

protractors.definition: n. drafting instrument used to draw or measure angles
protractors.translation: n. 量角器, 分度规( protractor的复数形式 )

protracts.definition: v lengthen in time; cause to be or last longer
protracts.translation: v. <贬>延长, 拖延（某事物）( protract的第三人称单数 )

protreptic.translation:
n. 规劝, 劝告
a. 规劝的, 劝告的

protriptyline.definition: n tricyclic antidepressant used to treat clinical depression
protriptyline.translation: [化] 普罗替林; 丙氨环庚烯

protropin.translation: [医]硝甲阿托品丙酸酯（解痉药）

protrudable.definition: a. That may be protruded; protrusile.

protrude.definition:
v extend out or project in space
v bulge outward
v swell or protrude outwards
protrude.translation:
vi. 伸出, 突出
vt. 使伸出, 使突出

protruded.translation: v. （使某物）伸出, （使某物）突出( protrude的过去式和过去分词 )

protruded packing.translation: [化] 多孔填料; 冲压填料

protrudent.translation: a. 突出的, 伸出的

protrudes.definition:
v extend out or project in space
v bulge outward
v swell or protrude outwards
protrudes.translation: v. （使某物）伸出, （使某物）突出( protrude的第三人称单数 )

protruding.definition:
v extend out or project in space
v bulge outward
v swell or protrude outwards
s extending out above or beyond a surface or boundary
protruding.translation: v. （使某物）伸出, （使某物）突出( protrude的现在分词 ); 凸

protrusible.definition: s capable of being thrust forward, as the tongue

protrusile.definition: s. capable of being thrust forward, as the tongue

protrusio acetabuli.translation: [医] 髋臼前突, [髋]关节内陷

protrusion.definition: n. the act of projecting out from something
protrusion.translation:
n. 突出, 突出部, 露出
[医] 前突, 突出

protrusions.definition:
n. something that bulges out or is protuberant or projects from its surroundings
n. the act of projecting out from something
protrusions.translation: n. 伸出, 突出( protrusion的复数形式 )

protrusive.translation: a. 伸出的, 突出的, 招人注意的

protrypsin.translation: [医] 前胰蛋白酶, 胰蛋白酶原
